value.rationale: The rank-one nilpotent orbit is a canonical matrix similarity class. Its complete additive self-convolution is a natural exact invariant; the formula quantifies every target rather than routine existence, shows a sharp characteristic-two scalar obstruction, and reduces higher-dimensional fibers to eigenline counts on a two-space. This is a structural, field-uniform classification with explicit relevance to nilpotent-orbit additive geometry, not merely an isolated finite calculation.
